insights.insight: A cryptographically verified receipt eliminates the attribution problem ad tech is paid to approximate — no pixel, no lookback window, no modeled conversion. At ~$0.10 per verified signal versus $5–$150 CPA in probabilistic ad tech, the cost delta is structural, not incremental.

With Chrome joining Safari and Firefox in deprecating cookies, device fingerprinting under regulatory pressure, and first-party data blind outside a single ecosystem, no current stack produces identity-free, cross-ecosystem verified purchase signals — this protocol does.

Amazon knows Amazon buyers; Walmart knows Walmart buyers; neither knows the aggregate. A cross-ecosystem verified purchase dataset that requires no data-sharing agreement is structurally superior to any single retailer's first-party data for market-level demand intelligence.

19 active metro and non-metro markets with 4 new entries this cycle, spanning both coasts and the upper Midwest — with no paid acquisition signal. Burst-quiet-burst diffusion pattern indicates social graph propagation, a leading indicator of durable network effects.

insights.topic: Category breadth expanding to DTC digital
insights.insight: Category entropy hit its highest recorded level at 3.176 bits, and the first DTC digital commerce brand entered the top brand list after 130+ cycles of physical retail only — the verified receipt window now captures online purchases alongside in-store.

Zero new DKIM vendor activations this cycle means receipt ingestion is gated on a list of 10 vendors — a hard ceiling on data throughput that limits how broadly the aggregate can scale and should be treated as a key due-diligence flag.
